There's no statistically significant association between IBS and R L1 radiculopathy in the data. Across 16,384 patients, the chi-square test gives p = 0.27 and Fisher's exact test gives p = 0.21. Only 12 patients have both labels, against about 8.5 expected by chance. That is too weak to support a causal link in either direction, so the most likely answer is that none exists.
